source: paper1_isa_supplement_v5.pdf Section S3.1 and Fig. S2
figure_note: The tau_min-normalized power law is supplement Fig. S2 in v5. In the v4.1 copy it was main-text Fig. 2. Cite it as Fig. S2.

fit_scope.omitted: the 1 ms column is omitted because its noise-free error is negligible (an essentially exact fit, < 0.01%)

sensor_noise_caveat: The sensor-noise branch is deliberately NOT overlaid on the power law. Under tension-only sensor noise the error does not collapse onto it (fitted exponent +0.41, R^2 ~ 0.11), so an SN fit would contradict its own trend. Do not draw an SN power-law line.
